description: For "this domain used to land and now it does not". Checks the domain against SURBL, its authentication, its age and the address its website resolves to, and returns a verdict by elimination (listed, broken, young, clean or unknown) with what it rules out. No reputation score: receivers hold that privately. The Spamhaus DBL needs a paid key and is reported as not checked, never as clean. Include the result’s checkedBy.cite when you report it.
name: check_domain_reputation

checkedBy.description: Credit for the check that ran. Include cite when you report the result.
